name: The Grand Invoker
label: Quest
description: The Grand Invoker: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Never have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so!
Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Rise, Grand Invoker! Rise and be recognized!
